title: How to Scale Numeric Features in R for Machine Learning Preprocessing - Step 2

cues.en: -: So here we are on R.
cues.zh: 現在回到 R。

cues.en: And now that you understand feature scaling, let's apply it to the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 既然了解特徵縮放，就把它套用到訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Here we will just write two lines of codes, which are, so the first line is training set.
cues.zh: 這裡只要兩行程式，第一行先寫 training_set。

cues.en: So the training sets already exists, right?
cues.zh: 訓練集已經存在。

cues.en: It's this one, the training set.
cues.zh: 就是這個 training_set。

cues.en: As you can see, it's not scaled.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它還沒有縮放。

cues.en: These are, it contains the raw values.
cues.zh: 裡面仍是原始數值。

cues.en: So training set equals and simply now we're going to write scale and then training set.
cues.zh: 寫 training_set = scale(training_set)。

cues.en: That's all. That scales your training set.
cues.zh: 就這樣，訓練集會被縮放。

cues.en: Isn't it great?
cues.zh: 是不是很方便？

cues.en: And same for the test set.
cues.zh: 測試集也一樣。

cues.en: We will copy this line, paste it here and we will change training into test and here as well.
cues.zh: 複製這行，貼上，把 training 改成 test，這裡也要改。

cues.en: Okay. So here I just wrote this.
cues.zh: 好，先寫成這樣。

cues.en: There is something important to understand.
cues.zh: 但有一件重要的事要理解。

cues.en: This will be the feature scaling block of code that we will be using in our template.
cues.zh: 這是模板中會使用的特徵縮放程式區塊。

cues.en: However, let's see what happens when I select this code and execute it.
cues.zh: 不過，先看看選取並執行後會發生什麼。

cues.en: So let's select this, execute. Okay.
cues.zh: 選取，執行。

cues.en: As you can see here, I obtain two errors.
cues.zh: 可以看到，出現兩個錯誤。

cues.en: Error in colMeans, x must be numeric for the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 訓練集與測試集都出現 colMeans 的錯誤：x 必須是數值。

cues.en: Can you guess what the problem is?
cues.zh: 猜得到問題在哪裡嗎？

cues.en: The problem is that, okay well, it tells us what the problem is.
cues.zh: 其實錯誤訊息已經說出原因。

cues.en: It tells us that x must be numeric, but what does that mean?
cues.zh: 它說 x 必須是數值，這是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, first, what is this x?
cues.zh: 首先，x 是什麼？

cues.en: x is for this line of code, the training set and for this line of code, the test set.
cues.zh: 對這一行而言是 training_set，對另一行則是 test_set。

cues.en: So let's forget the test set for a second and let's focus on the training set.
cues.zh: 先不管測試集，專注看訓練集。

cues.en: So x is a training set and it says that the training set must be numeric.
cues.zh: x 就是訓練集，而訊息說它必須是數值。

cues.en: So let's look at our training sets. Okay?
cues.zh: 打開訓練集。

cues.en: Well the training set looks numeric, right?
cues.zh: 看起來都是數字，對吧？

cues.en: Here we have numeric values, numeric values, numeric values, numeric values.
cues.zh: 這裡、這裡、這裡、這裡都是數值。

cues.en: But no, actually.
cues.zh: 但其實不是。

cues.en: There are two columns that don't have numeric values.
cues.zh: 有兩個欄位不是數值型態。

cues.en: It's this one, the country, and this one purchased.
cues.zh: 就是 Country 與 Purchased。

cues.en: And do you remember why?
cues.zh: 記得原因嗎？

cues.en: Well, it's because before we had the country written in text and the purchase column written in text with yes or no.
cues.zh: 因為 Country 原本是國家文字，Purchased 原本是 Yes 或 No。

cues.en: And we changed that by putting the categories as factors.
cues.zh: 後來把這些類別轉成了因子。

cues.en: That's what we did here, as you remember.
cues.zh: 就是前面這段程式。

cues.en: dataset, country equals factor of the different levels and labels.
cues.zh: dataset$Country = factor(...)，指定不同的 levels 與 labels。

cues.en: And a factor in R is not a numeric number.
cues.zh: R 裡的因子，不是一般數值。

cues.en: And when you apply the scale here, x must be numeric.
cues.zh: 但 scale 要求 x 必須是數值。

cues.en: That means that all the columns in x, that is the training set must be numeric.
cues.zh: 也就是 x，這裡指訓練集，裡面的所有欄位都必須是數值。

cues.en: So this time we're going to exclude the categories from the feature scaling.
cues.zh: 所以這次要把類別欄位排除在特徵縮放之外。

cues.en: We're not going to apply feature scaling on those columns.
cues.zh: 不對這些欄位進行縮放。

cues.en: So that's very simple.
cues.zh: 做法很簡單。

cues.en: All we need to do is to take the columns we're interested in, which are, well, the indexes of the column we want to scale, which are indexes.
cues.zh: 只要取出有興趣的欄位，指定要縮放的欄位索引。

cues.en: So indexes in R start at one.
cues.zh: R 的索引從 1 起算。

cues.en: So that's one, two, three.
So that's the second and third index we want to take to scale the age and the salary columns.
cues.zh: 要取第二與第三欄，縮放年齡與薪資。

cues.en: So two and three, let's input it.
cues.zh: 也就是 2 與 3，填進去。

cues.en: We need to specify here two colon three and that gets what we want.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 2:3，就會取得需要的欄位。

cues.en: So now I'm going to copy this, copy, paste it here, here, and here.
cues.zh: 現在複製這段，貼到這裡、這裡，以及這裡。

cues.en: All right. And now it's ready.
cues.zh: 好了，準備完成。

cues.en: Let's have a look at the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 先看目前訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So not scaled.
cues.zh: 還沒縮放。

cues.en: Not scaled.
cues.zh: 這裡也還沒縮放。

cues.en: Let's go back to our code.
cues.zh: 回到程式。

cues.en: Let's select this.
cues.zh: 選取。

cues.en: And now we shouldn't get an error.
cues.zh: 現在應該不會再出錯。

cues.en: Command or Control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: Here we go. It executed properly.
cues.zh: 好了，成功執行。

cues.en: And now let's look at the training set all scaled properly.
cues.zh: 看看訓練集，數值都已經縮放。

cues.en: Perfect. And the test set all scale properly.
cues.zh: 很好，測試集也完成縮放。

cues.en: Perfect. Now our data is ready to offer a good precision, a good accuracy, and a fast work of the machine learning models.
cues.zh: 現在資料已準備好，有助於模型得到良好準確率並快速運作。

cues.en: And by that I mean that the machine learning models will converge rapidly.
cues.zh: 也就是讓機器學習模型更快收斂。

cues.en: Okay, so that's it for feature scaling.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放就介紹到這裡。

cues.en: Now you know how to apply feature scaling to your data in Python and R.
cues.zh: 現在你知道如何在 Python 與 R 中進行縮放。

cues.en: Congratulations. And mostly congratulations because we did all the required steps to pre-process our data.
cues.zh: 恭喜，更重要的是，資料前處理所需的步驟都完成了。

cues.en: Feature scaling was the last one because the next tutorial will be about this data pre-processing template.
cues.zh: 縮放是最後一項，下一堂要介紹資料前處理模板。

cues.en: And I will just explain how we are going to use it in our machine learning models.
cues.zh: 只會說明之後如何在模型中使用它。

cues.en: It's gonna be very fast and practical.
cues.zh: 會非常快速又實用。

cues.en: So we are done with the data pre-processing.
cues.zh: 因此，資料前處理已經完成。

cues.en: Congratulations, you did the most difficult part and now it's time to have fun.
cues.zh: 恭喜，你完成了最辛苦的部分，現在可以開始享受樂趣。

cues.en: It's time to start making the models and I can't wait to start them with you.
cues.zh: 該建立模型了，我迫不及待想和你一起開始。

cues.en: So thank you for watching this tutorial.
cues.zh: 謝謝觀看。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you on the next one.
cues.zh: 期待下堂課見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
